# Local country/region flag icons

Source and documentation: https://flagpedia.net/download/api
Download: https://flagcdn.com/w80.zip
The service documents these flags as based on Wikimedia Commons vector files and provides free programmatic download for use in projects.

Included here: 250 two-letter country/region PNG files, width80. Hashes and source links are recorded in flags/sources.json.
Use: display the country/region code returned by the user-enabled IP lookup. The application does not fetch flag images at runtime.

No FlClash assets or executable components are included. The supplied Conan background is an existing project asset.
